question: Will an episode of a registered technical event (technical value or connection-loss state) start on the channel in [issued_at, issued_at + H)?
interpretation: registered technical event of a channel; not a confirmed breakdown (the cause is known only after a field visit)

source.epoch_rows: rows with is_epoch_placeholder are kept when event_ts_local_raw parses: the epoch is the VALUE of 'Состояние охраны', not the timestamp
source.alarm_level: alarm is evaluated per channel x timestamp: numeric rows never carry alarm=true, the paired text row at the same timestamp does

technical_value.clean: in scope, technical reason NULL and a numeric value (value_numeric or parsed value_raw); text rows such as 'Неисправен' are neutral
technical_value.status: Head DS 2026-09-26: epoch_value excluded from the main label; temperature is the main numeric case, gas reported separately

technical_value_epoch.clean: as main; for 'Состояние охраны' any non-technical value_raw is clean

connection_loss.clean: value_raw IS NOT NULL, in scope, not a candidate state of any rule and not neutral
connection_loss.status: technologist classification 2026-09-26 (TECHNOLOGIST_REVIEW.md), agent role, not customer approval

connection_loss_s2.role: sensitivity S2: S1 + 'Неисправен' of pumps and fans (status bundle, report separately)

connection_loss_end_undetermined.role: sensitivity: 'Неопределен' is clean, so an episode ends at the first 'Неопределен'

episode.q_status: recommended by the development measurement 2026-09-26; pending Head DS decision
episode.start: candidate timestamp with no candidate of the label in the previous Q hours and at least one clean timestamp since the previous candidate (a channel stuck in the state stays in one episode)
episode.end: first clean-only timestamp strictly after the start; NULL = open at data end
episode.simultaneous: a timestamp with candidate and clean rows is a candidate timestamp with a conflict; it neither ends an episode nor is ordered
episode.min_duration_rule: duration-conditioned label: count only starts whose episode lasts >= d hours or is open at data end; start detection and active_episode use all episodes

cluster.w_status: organizers' reference; pending Head DS decision
cluster.rule: episode starts sorted in time; a start joins the current cluster when the gap to the previous start of the same object and label is <= W minutes (chaining)

exclusion_precedence.note: model: window-level reasons first (identical for all channels of an object x sensor type), then channel eligibility

measurement.claim_check: share of connection-loss starts in object clusters of 5-75 channels within 10 minutes

not_labels.note: never candidates; 'Не определено', 'Выключен', 'Много неисправных устройств' and 'Неопределен' are neutral (neither start nor end); other determined states are clean. Temperature 'Не определено' with -127 belongs to technical_value (features catalogue). Epoch-date rows are dropped.

splits_note: periods of configs/sensor_failure_model_v1.json; cutoffs before 2019-01-31 map to 'excluded' with reason insufficient_lookback

connection_loss_s1_1h.label: connection_loss_s1
connection_loss_s1_1h.role: declared sensitivity: S1 state list, same >= 1 h filter as main

connection_loss_s2_1h.label: connection_loss_s2
connection_loss_s2_1h.role: declared sensitivity: S2 (pumps/fans), reported separately, same >= 1 h filter

targets_rule.qualifying_episode: min_duration_hours null -> every episode; else duration >= min or open at data end
targets_rule.channel_label: y=1 if a qualifying episode of the channel starts in [t, t+H)
targets_rule.event: cluster of episode starts of the label (Q, W of the model config); qualifies if >= 1 member episode is qualifying
targets_rule.card: object_id x sensor_type; y_card=1 if a qualifying event starts in [t, t+H) and has a member on a candidate channel of the card
targets_rule.candidate: known before t, not in an active episode and not in the Q shadow at t (only information before t)
targets_rule.weekly: horizon 168 h is issued on Mondays 00:00; other days get exclusion reason not_weekly_cutoff
